title: How may an Auto Loans borrower change the monthly due day?
content:
# How may an Auto Loans borrower change the monthly due day?

This policy of the Auto Loans product category at PCB governs moving the monthly due day of an auto loan. Each product applies its own number of changes per rolling window and its own largest move of the due day.

## Clauses

1. **Range.** A borrower may move the monthly due day to another day from 1 to 28.
2. **Size of the move.** The new due day may differ from the current one by at most the product's largest move, in calendar days, in either direction, counted within the month.
3. **Loan condition.** The loan must be active with no installment past due, as shown on the loan record.
4. **Frequency.** Every product allows its number of due date changes per rolling window of 365 calendar days. A due date change is allowed only when 365 calendar days have passed since the last change, or when there has been no earlier change.
5. **Effect.** The next due date moves to the new day in the month of the current next payment due date. Interest keeps accruing daily, so a later due day means more interest in that installment. The maturity date is not changed, and no fee is charged.

## Counting the 365 days

- Clock start: the date of the last due date change on the loan record.
- Count calendar days with the day after that date as day 1.
- A new change is allowed when today is **on or after** the last change date plus 365 days; the boundary day itself qualifies. A loan with no earlier change is not held back by this clause.

## Boundary case (hypothetical dates)

Last change on 2027-02-11. The last change date plus 365 days is 2028-02-11.

| Today | Frequency test |
|---|---|
| 2028-02-10 | not met |
| 2028-02-11 | met |

## Effect illustration (hypothetical loan)

| Current next due date | New due day | New next due date |
|---|---|---|
| 2027-10-05 | 18 | 2027-10-18 |
| 2027-10-20 | 8 | 2027-10-08 |

## Points of judgement

**Can a delinquent loan change its due day?** No; the loan must be active with no installment past due.

**Does moving the due day later cost a fee or extend the loan?** No fee is charged and the maturity date is unchanged, but the installment on the later day carries more interest because interest accrues daily.
